question: Choose the word that is the most appropriate synonym of the word "**reliable**".
solution:
The correct answer is: **Trustworthy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Reliable"** means someone or something that can be trusted or depended upon. (विश्वसनीय)
 
 
• **Example:** She is a reliable employee who always meets her deadlines.
 
 
• **"Trustworthy"** refers to a person or entity that is deserving of trust or confidence. It is a synonym for reliable. (भरोसेमंद)
 
 
• **Example:** A trustworthy friend will always keep your secrets safe.
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **'Reliable' **is **'Trustworthy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Trustworthy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Uncertain **(अनिश्चित): Something that is not clearly defined or is doubtful.
 
 
• **Example:** The outcome of the election remains uncertain until all votes are counted.
 
 
 
• **Untrue **(असत्य): Something that is false or not based on fact.
 
 
• **Example:** The rumor about her leaving the company turned out to be untrue.
 
 
 
• **False** (झूठा): Something that is intentionally deceptive or incorrect.
 
 
• **Example:** He gave a false statement to mislead the investigation.
